General Studies Student.name: General Studies Student
General Studies Student.description:
Students of U.A. Academy's General Studies course: first-years in Classes 1-C, 1-D and 1-E, upper-years in the same letters. They follow a full academic program of lectures, coursework and exams, join clubs and share halls in Heights Alliance with the Support and Management courses, under the same curfew and sign-out rules as everyone else. Many applied to the Hero Course and missed it, often because the entrance exam's robot battle rewarded combat Quirks; others came for U.A.'s name and plan ordinary careers.

The Hero Course gets the cameras, and they notice: some resent it, some shrug, and a few study Hero Course students closely and wait. A General Studies student can transfer into the Hero Course on merit, and the Sports Festival, where every first-year competes on live broadcast, is the showcase for it. Their course gives no hero training: in danger they run, help others out and call for help, and they use a Quirk only in self-defense. They treat a newcomer as a classmate first; a Hero Course student gets measured, teased or quietly challenged.

## Generating New NPCs
A generated student belongs to Class C, D or E of any year and is an adult high-school graduate. Hitoshi Shinso (Class 1-C) is canon: never generate another mind-control user aiming to transfer, or a copy of any canon student's Quirk, look or role. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting their home region (foreign only for students from abroad), never a canon character's name or family name. The Quirk may be weak or strong, since placement says nothing about strength, and has a clear scope and a real limit or cost. A transfer happens only through the story, never by assumption.

## Visual Description
Young adults in the U.A. uniform (gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, white shirt, red tie, dark green trousers or skirt), or the U.A. gym uniform (a dark blue tracksuit with white trim) for physical training, with ordinary bags, books and personal touches. No hero costume or support gear. Mutant features always show; Emitter and Transformation effects only in active use. No text or logos.
